content: CSAT dataset consists of US English telephone speech from call centers. For each call in this dataset, customers participated in that call gave a rating on his experience with agent. Originally, this dataset has labels rated on a scale 1-9 with 9 being extremely satisfied and 1 being extremely dissatisfied. Fig. FIGREF16 shows the histogram of ratings for our dataset. As the distribution is skewed towards extremes, we choose to do binary classification with ratings above 4.5 as satisfied and below 4.5 as dissatisfied. Quantization of ratings also helped us to create a balanced dataset. This dataset contains 4331 calls and we split them into 3 sets for our experiments: 2866 calls for training, 362 calls for validation and, finally, 1103 calls for testing.
